protocol.route: P2 thrust and body-rate BPTT, PyTorch dynamic flexible rope
protocol.goal: User explicitly requested further30s targeted training for remaining0.650/0.663m weak-wind cases
protocol.adaptation_reason: Increase0.5/1mps initial-state coverage without training on evaluation seeds/directions;retain strong-wind samples

sensors.group: IMU + idealized onboard attitude + simulated motor-speed feedback + barometer (user authorized)
sensors.limitation: Attitude estimate is truth plus modeled errors, not a validated inertial estimator. RPM feedback and barometric reference calibration require hardware verification.

preflight_baro_calibration.method: OLS biasandlinear drift from past barometer measurements

offline_limits.status: Provisional simulation termination limits, not deployable safety guarantees or measured hardware limits

conditioning.context_source: calibrated airframe and actuator configuration only

training.dynamic_rope_objective: actual path+heading+convergence; no stale-node target counterfactual

provenance.vehicle_parameters: Constants imported earlier from the RflyTower LW_noaileron MATLAB/Simulink model;measured hardware validation is pending.
provenance.cm_table: Retained numerical interpolation table in configs/cm_table.json;physical wing loads are disabled by model.py.
provenance.body_drag: Quadratic body drag coefficients [0.055,0.055,0.055] N/(m/s)^2;nominal simulated values,not measured.
provenance.tether: Pull-only elastic massless straight tether;stiffness10N/m,damping2;body-fixed5/10cm points and rest lengths4.90/4.85m configured by environment.py;no sag model.
provenance.controller: GRU rate/thrust references followed by heading hold,body-rate PI,RPM-derived thrust PI,and allocation;no horizontal truth controller.
provenance.numerics: Rigid-body RK4,first-order motor dynamics;CUDA forward/VJP graph used for BPTT.
provenance.scope: Local numerical simulation only;no hardware I/O.

qualification.estimation: Linear extrapolation; actual10s credit memory, wind and failures can change throughput
